plan.title: Vendor bid refuses empty required Brand field

steps.note: Open a suitable existing live event that is still accepting quotes.
Move to the invited vendor's separate supplier-portal session.
Open the event's RFQ bid sheet in the vendor portal.
Confirm the required buyer-added Brand column is present on the vendor's bid form.
Submit a bid priced at 100 while leaving the Brand text field empty; the required-field refusal is the expected outcome.
